text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "The Takamatsunomiya Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Entering this arena where the boastful fastest gathered
was that Tiara Umamusume,
who had carved supremacy and history alike.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby is one of those who,
in pursuit of ultimate speed, demonstrated the potential
of Tiara Umamusume as sprinters.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl set a historic milestone.
Starting with this G1 race, within a single year,
she went on to become the first Japanese horse to conquer a European G1.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Then what will I prove from here on?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the bus heading to Chukyo Racecourse,
Rhein Kraft was holding her head in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um... since I declared it on New Year's Day, I feel like I really have to accomplish something, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I was reminded once again... that surpassing
our seniors is an incredibly high hurdle to clear."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: North Flight-san has already achieved the Spring-Autumn Mile double. And she also achieved the Spring-Autumn Sprint double, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Are there any races left
where my winning would make everyone
go absolutely wild with excitement?"
choice_data_list: You don't have to fixate on being the first in history, you know?
There's no need to obsess over being the first in history, is there?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh.
Doesn't it kinda lack punch~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, the title of 'first in history'
has the magic to captivate people in an instant.
However—"
choice_data_list: Are your favorite races only the "first in history" ones?
Do you only like races that are 'firsts in history'?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...No.
Not Sweep's Shuka Sho.
Nor Air Groove's Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Every single race
with the Tiara Umamusume... I love them all so much.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I loved seeing the Tiara Umamusume shining bright, and that made me want to watch this race, and want to run in it too.
choice_data_list: Then let's shine so you won't be outdone.
Then you shine just as brightly so you don't lose to them.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes!!
I'm gonna put everything I've got into this first race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think Daitaku Helios
is to Rhein Kraft?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, are you keeping Daiichi Ruby's
Takamatsunomiya Kinen in mind with that~?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I never thought crafting would end up leading to
conversations about Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha. It's not just Ruby.
Come on, just take a look—

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Star Paka Petit, all rerunning at once!
The sprint queen who conquered the world,
Seeking the Pearl is back too!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey mister, do you have any Hishi Amazon ones?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! ...Wait, whoaaaaa?!
Hishi Amazon?! Whoa! The real deal?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! It's the real deal!
Hahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right? Unbelievable, isn't it!
Just a single word from Craft
sparked everyone's interest!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—...Takes you by surprise, doesn't it?
Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. We need to see every last bit of what she's capable of.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —That heroic figure who vowed to surpass us.
